messages.content: The supplier has changed Thursday's meeting. It is now at their Princeton facility near Alexander Road, starts at 8:00 a.m., and is still expected to finish around noon. My Philadelphia conference and the 5:10 p.m. flight from Newark are unchanged. I need to replace the Wednesday rail and Hampton plan.

The rail plan no longer works because the facility is not practical to reach from Newark that early. I can map a Wednesday rental from central Philadelphia, an overnight near the Princeton site, and a Thursday drive to EWR. Is the conference still ending at 4:15 p.m., with your luggage held at the Philadelphia Marriott?
Yes. I can retrieve the bag immediately afterward. Compare one-way rentals that stay open late enough, including all one-way charges, and two refundable hotels close to the facility.

Two workable rentals are available Wednesday. Enterprise at 30th Street is open until 6:00 p.m.; pickup at 5:00 p.m. and return at EWR Thursday by 2:30 p.m. totals $154.70, including the $48 one-way fee. Hertz at the Philadelphia Marriott location is also open until 6:00 p.m.; the same return window totals $181.26, including a $62 one-way fee. Both include unlimited mileage. Avis on North 17th closes at 5:00 p.m., so I excluded it because the conference timing leaves too little margin.
Enterprise is the sensible one. What are the hotel choices, and how long are the drives?

Hyatt Place Princeton is 2.8 miles from the facility, about 8-12 minutes Thursday morning. A refundable king room is $198.44 including tax, with cancellation through 6:00 p.m. local time September 19. Courtyard Princeton is 4.6 miles away, about 12-18 minutes, at $184.17 including tax; it is refundable through 11:59 p.m. September 18. Both have overnight self-parking included. From central Philadelphia, allow 60-80 minutes Wednesday evening. From the facility to the Enterprise return at EWR, allow 45-65 minutes in normal midday traffic.
Use the Hyatt. Before booking, give me the Thursday timing with a reasonable meeting overrun. I do not want the rental return to put the flight at risk.

Leave the Hyatt at 7:20 a.m. for an expected arrival around 7:30-7:40. If the meeting runs 45 minutes late, depart the facility at 12:45 p.m. Allowing 65 minutes to EWR plus 20 minutes for fuel and rental processing puts the car return around 2:10 p.m. The AirTrain should get you to the terminal around 2:30-2:40, leaving roughly 2 hours 30 minutes before the 5:10 p.m. departure. Treat 1:15 p.m. as the latest departure from the facility; that still targets a return by about 2:40 p.m.
That works. Book Enterprise and the Hyatt, then cancel the Hampton. Do not touch either flight or the Philadelphia Marriott.

I will make only those three changes: reserve Enterprise for Philadelphia-to-EWR, book the Hyatt Place Princeton for Wednesday night, and cancel Hampton confirmation HN8K27. Ticket record C4P8VN and Philadelphia Marriott confirmation PM6D41 will remain unchanged.

Completed. Enterprise confirmation EP7R53 is reserved for pickup at 5:00 p.m. Wednesday, September 20, at 30th Street and return by 2:30 p.m. Thursday at EWR, totaling $154.70. Hyatt Place Princeton confirmation HP4K86 is booked for September 20-21 at $198.44, including tax and parking, refundable through 6:00 p.m. local time September 19. Hampton confirmation HN8K27 has been canceled within its deadline; the cancellation number is CX5N14 and no charge applies.
Restate the complete final itinerary and recalculate the trip total. Include what is confirmed, the Wednesday drive, Thursday cutoff, and the first remaining cancellation deadline.

Confirmed itinerary: Sunday, September 17, fly American nonstop SFO-PHL from 8:05 a.m. to 4:31 p.m. on ticket record C4P8VN. Stay at Philadelphia Marriott Downtown, confirmation PM6D41, September 17-20 for $912.48, and attend the conference through 4:15 p.m. Wednesday. Retrieve your luggage, leave the hotel around 4:35 p.m., reach Enterprise at 30th Street for the 5:00 p.m. pickup, then drive approximately 60-80 minutes to Hyatt Place Princeton. Enterprise confirmation EP7R53 is $154.70. Hyatt confirmation HP4K86 is $198.44 for Wednesday night.

Thursday, leave the Hyatt at 7:20 a.m. for the 8:00 a.m. meeting. Depart the facility at 12:45 p.m. if it runs 45 minutes late, and no later than 1:15 p.m. Return the car at EWR, take the AirTrain to the terminal, and fly United nonstop EWR-SFO from 5:10 p.m. to 8:22 p.m. on the unchanged ticket record. Airfare remains $676.

The confirmed trip total is $1,941.62: $676 airfare, $912.48 Philadelphia hotel, $198.44 Princeton hotel, and $154.70 rental. Allowing $34 for fuel and tolls gives a working total of $1,975.62. The Hampton and unbooked rail plan are removed. The first remaining cancellation deadline is the Philadelphia Marriott at 6:00 p.m. Philadelphia time September 14; the Hyatt deadline follows at 6:00 p.m. local time September 19.
